content.about: Ghana lies on the Gulf of Guinea in West Africa. It was the first sub-Saharan African country to gain independence from colonial rule, in 1957. Its coast has old castles from the slave trade. Kente cloth and cocoa are famous.

standout.text: Lake Volta in Ghana is one of the largest artificial lakes by area.

didYouKnow: Ghana was formerly called the Gold Coast.
Kente cloth is woven in strips.
Ghana is one of the world's top cocoa producers.
